name: master-of-plow-participant-source
layoutNotes: The CustomUI source lives in customui-src/. That is the path the SeamOS
IDE resolves with no configuration, so a clone builds without a local
.seamos-workspace.json or .seamos-context.json (both are machine-local and
intentionally gitignored).
master_of_plow_CPP_SDK/ is part of the deliverable because the C++ build
resolves it via FIND_PACKAGE and a clone opened on another machine has no
other source for it. It is gitignored in the development workspace and
committed in the participant repository.
master_of_plow_app/ui/ is build output of customui-src/, and it IS part of
the deliverable. Two build paths exist and only one regenerates it: the
SeamOS IDE FIF build calls buildReactCustomUiIfNeeded at the start of the
package stage (npm ci + vite build, and it throws if index.html is not
produced), while the build-fif.sh / nvx-fif-gen path copies the app
directory as-is and never runs npm. Without the committed output that
second path packages a FIF whose static/ is empty. It is 423 KB.
Three things are intentionally different in the participant repository:
.gitignore carries the SeamOS IDE managed block (which un-ignores
*_CPP_SDK/** and, per the IDE generator, ignores <app>/ui/ — the
participant repository re-includes it) and README.md is participant-facing
rather than workspace-facing. Everything else is copied byte-for-byte.
seamos-assets/ follows the upload-app skill convention: iconImage.png,
mainImage.png, screenshots/screenshot*.png, and builds/ for packaged FIFs.
The .fif files themselves are build output and never ship; the .gitkeep
placeholders keep builds/ present in a fresh clone.
customui-src/ carries only the dashboard the feature ships. The simulator
sources it was forked from — src/simulation, src/components, src/3d,
src/protocol, src/state, the Playwright suite, the asset tooling, and the
public/ assets none of them referenced — are deliberately absent.
